I used a BASH script that used the standard UNIX dictionary (with my words) to generate 2-6 words, then piped it into Lynx. It then discarded the results and did it again 5 minutes later. The entire thing ran on a Pi, but could run happily on anything that is *nix.

I probably still have the script, give me a few days and I'll see if I can find it.

Ok, found the base code, although I had some other stuff in there too (it used to tweet the words to an account called goobfustic)

#!/bin/bash
howmany=$(( ( RANDOM % 5 ) + 2 ))
for (( i=1; i<=howmany; i++ ))
 do
 getone=`shuf -n1 /usr/share/dict/american-english-insane`
 words+="${getone} "
 done
echo "$words"
lynx -dump "https://www.google.com/search?q=$words"

This generates 2-6 words from the "american-english-insane" dictionary, and then searches the with lynx. It dumps the results, then exits.
